body: hall9k v0.13.4 is released (all five assets up, cleared as Latest). It ships #762 (pr-summary asks for a before-and-after scenario on visible behavior changes) and #763 (h9k learn distill cuts a research spike instead of a Research task). Please run h9k update --restart, confirm h9k --version prints 0.13.4 and the daemon is up, then reply here.
